data.title: 夜莺 · 蓝色丝带
data.description: 书上的蓝丝带松开了，她重新系好，把蝴蝶结留在书脊旁边。
data.promptProse: At an antique writing bureau bathed in afternoon window glow, Nightingale carefully knots a slender cornflower-blue silk ribbon around a pressed volume of healing hymns. Vials of medicinal tinctures, dried lavender bundles, and illuminated parchment pages create a tranquil, sacred sanctuary around her tender movements.
data.animaCaption: Seated at an antique writing bureau, she carefully knots a slender blue silk ribbon around a pressed book of hymns beside tincture vials and dried lavender. Warm afternoon window light bathes her tender hands.
